intentionalDifferences: Generic asset submit/status/poll/result/cancel orchestration remains owned by Sine AI; the upstream SDK does not expose a generic AssetModelV1 executor.
Retry policy, signal composition, and callback merging are delegated directly to pinned AI SDK helpers through one internal integration module.
Submission retries default to zero and require explicit model idempotency capability for a positive count; status retries default to two.
The asset layer does not maintain its own Retry-After/backoff algorithm or per-attempt/retry callback protocol.
Timeout and cancellation are cooperative signals; there is no general promise race, strict wall-clock deadline layer, or terminal callback state machine.
The five lifecycle callbacks are awaited observations whose errors are ignored by the SDK; critical persistence must be awaited after startAsset returns.
Operation envelopes bind provider, model, kind, and specification version and validate and freeze their JSON payload.
URL assets remain references and are not downloaded implicitly.
Webhook notification waiting retains a local race with SDK delay; provider requests remain cooperatively cancellable.
Cancellation is an explicit provider operation; local abort does not cancel the remote job.
Custom poll.delay replaces polling sleeps only and does not make the executor durable.
